about.title: About Me
about.description: Professional with 9 years of experience in financial markets, with solid work on trading desks and in building quantitative solutions. Combines technical knowledge and market insight to automate routines, build dashboards and reports, and implement data-intensive strategies. Strong command of Python, Excel, VBA, the Bloomberg Terminal and API integration (BLPAPI), with experience in backtests, trade execution, portfolio allocation and support for portfolio managers. Uses AI intensively for ideation and implementation of solutions, including automation of internal processes.
